undetected_population.parameter_provenance: UNCALIBRATED engineering validation prior: one initially undetected object per class in the image Gaussian footprint; independent Poisson immigration 0.2 objects/s per class; zero velocity mean and sigma about sqrt(5)/(7300*0.1) rad/s. Not a calibration or an admission threshold. PPP intensity Gaussian-merged; miss-conditioned shape retained approximately.

tracking.parameter_provenance: default-v2; sensor/R/PD/survival inherited from the reference parameter set; CV acceleration spectrum q_a set to 1e-7, 3-30x above the innovation-likelihood optima (3e-9..3e-8) of formal tracks in segments 01 and 09 (2 s frames), leaving margin for manoeuvres; selection-biased toward smooth tracks; UNCALIBRATED

clutter.parameter_provenance: existing V2 real diagnostic Gamma(2,4) prior mean .5, applied to the full image as an UNCALIBRATED engineering default; reference false_alarm_probability=.05 is a per-track evidence likelihood, not a Poisson image count

background.parameter_provenance: V2 static inertial background model; shared inherited PD/R are engineering reuse, not independently calibrated star parameters

bootstrap.birth_scope: undetected target and uncatalogued-star Poisson populations; every valid frame may produce first-detection candidates in the same source update; no fixed finite birth cohort
